name: AI Mind Vault
install: for d in .cursor/tools repos/AI-Mind-Portable/.cursor/tools /agent/repos/AI-Mind-Portable/.cursor/tools; do [ -d "$d" ] && cd "$d" && break; done && npm ci

terminals.name: vault-preview
terminals.command: for d in .cursor/tools repos/AI-Mind-Portable/.cursor/tools /agent/repos/AI-Mind-Portable/.cursor/tools; do [ -d "$d" ] && cd "$d" && break; done && node preview_server.mjs
terminals.description: Local Markdown preview server for the vault (resolves [[wikilinks]]). Serves http://localhost:4321 — home page, /view/<note>.md, /healthz.
